text: Straight-talk dentist, No B.S. diagnosis. Reasonable cost and attentive staff. Definitely will go back if need arises.

To the person using the name "secret secretzone": Please provide the full name of the patient you claim to have, and a medical certificate stating that the illness resulted from the dental service. If the claims are true, the clinic will gladly take responsibility.
Regarding the claim of "throwing something into the patient's throat," what does that mean? Patients are not under general anesthesia during dental procedures. If there were any foreign objects, the patient would be immediately conscious. It's impossible for someone to intentionally throw something into another person's throat.
Concerning the sterilization of instruments, the clinic uses a standard autoclave that meets all requirements of the Medical Council (as shown in the actual photos used in the clinic) and is registered annually according to Ministry of Public Health standards.
You can inspect this at the clinic anytime.
Finally, to the person using the name "secret secretzone," if you and the patient you claim to have existed, and the illness described did occur and can be proven to have been caused by the dental service, with an official certificate from the treating physician, the clinic will gladly take responsibility. Please contact us.
However, if the claims cannot be proven, the clinic considers them baseless and unsubstantiated accusations, especially since the accuser is too afraid to reveal their face and real name. The clinic reserves the right to pursue legal action to the fullest extent.
For your information.
Rak Fun Dental Clinic
